must_have_properties: BAR0/BAR1 shall expose the standard NVMe register set with CAP @ 0h, VS @ 8h, INTMS @ Ch, INTMC @ 10h, CC @ 14h, CSTS @ 1Ch, AQA @ 24h, ASQ @ 28h, ACQ @ 30h.
Each Submission Queue Entry shall be 64 bytes; each Completion Queue Entry shall be at least 16 bytes.
Doorbell registers SQyTDBL / CQyHDBL shall begin at offset 1000h with stride (4 << CAP.DSTRD).
CSTS.RDY shall transition 0→1 within CAP.TO × 500 ms after CC.EN transitions 0→1 (assuming valid AQA/ASQ/ACQ/CC.MPS/CC.CSS).
CSTS.RDY shall transition 1→0 within CAP.TO × 500 ms after CC.EN transitions 1→0.
Phase Tag bit in each CQE shall be initialized to 0 after CC.EN 0→1 and shall invert on each pass through the CQ ring.
Controller shall return SQHD in every CQE so the host can update the visible SQ Head Pointer.
Controller shall accept Identify Controller (CNS=01h) and return a 4 KB structure with VID, SSVID, SN, MN, FR fields populated.
Admin SQ/CQ shall be queue ID 0 with sizes 2..4096 entries.
I/O SQ/CQ shall have sizes 2..(CAP.MQES+1) entries.
Host shall be able to perform a single 32-bit MMIO write to ring an SQ Tail Doorbell.
Fused Operation (Compare + Write) shall complete atomically when FUSE=01b is immediately followed by FUSE=10b in the same SQ.
Controller shall report Class Code 010802h in PCI Config Space.
PRP entries within a PRP List shall have zero offset; only the first PRP entry in a command may carry an offset.
If CAP.NSSRS = 1, writing 0x4E564D65 to NSSR shall trigger an NVM Subsystem Reset; reading NSSR shall return 0h.
Normal Shutdown (CC.SHN=01b) shall drain outstanding I/O and flush write cache before setting CSTS.SHST=10b.
Reserved bits in defined registers shall return 0h when read.
must_not_have_properties: Host shall NOT modify AQA, ASQ, ACQ while CC.EN=1; doing so produces undefined results.
Host shall NOT issue Create I/O Submission Queue referencing a non-existent CQID.
Host shall NOT delete a CQ that still has SQs attached.
Host shall NOT issue I/O commands to an SQ before CSTS.RDY=1.
Host shall NOT access INTMS/INTMC while configured for MSI-X.
Host shall NOT write a Tail Doorbell value larger than queue size; doing so generates an asynchronous event 'Invalid Doorbell Write Value' if an AER is outstanding.
Controller shall NOT process commands after CSTS.CFS=1 (fatal status).
Host shall NOT rely on a non-zero return from reserved registers.

compliance_failure_modes.trigger: Reserved or unsupported OPC in CDW0; CQE Status SC=0x01.
Reserved/invalid value in any defined field; CQE Status SC=0x02.
CID already in use on same SQ; SC=0x03.
Transient PCIe/fabric error during data transfer; SC=0x04.
Fatal controller error; CSTS.CFS=1; SC=0x06.
Non-zero offset on PRP List entry or non-aligned PRP; SC=0x13.
Invalid SGL Segment / Length / Type / Number; SC=0x0D..0x11.
Create I/O SQ references non-existent CQ; SC=0x01 (Cmd Specific).
Queue size 0 or larger than CAP.MQES+1; SC=0x02 (Cmd Specific).
Delete CQ with SQs attached; SC=0x0C (Cmd Specific).
Read/Write past namespace size (NSZE); SC=0x80.
Write would exceed namespace capacity (NCAP); SC=0x81.
Access denied by held reservation; SC=0x83.
Sanitize active; competing command rejected with SC=0x1D.
Namespace not yet ready (e.g. after Format); SC=0x82.
Compare command sees mismatch; SC=0x85.
ECC failure on Read; SC=0x281 (Media SCT=2h).
Media write failure; SC=0x280 (Media SCT=2h).
PI guard mismatch; SC=0x282.
PI app tag mismatch; SC=0x283.
PI ref tag mismatch; SC=0x284.
ANA Inaccessible / Persistent Loss / Transient Loss; SCT=3h.

fields.timeout_constraints: CAP.TO field (8 bits in 500 ms units) bounds CSTS.RDY transition; typical values are CAP.TO ≤ 60 (= 30 s). Keep Alive Timeout (KATO, Set Features FID 0Fh) bounds host-controller liveness for NVMe-oF (Base 1.4 also defines Keep Alive in PCIe).
fields.min_register_alignment_constraint: ASQ/ACQ shall be page-aligned per CC.MPS; PRP entries shall be dword-aligned; PRP List shall be page-aligned and contiguous within the page.
fields.reset_behavior_compliance: Three reset levels: (1) PCIe Conventional / FLR — full controller reset including PCI Config Space (where Sticky bits permit); (2) NVM Subsystem Reset — all controllers in subsystem reset, CSTS.NSSRO=1 after; (3) Controller Reset (CC.EN 1→0) — Admin Queue regs (AQA/ASQ/ACQ) preserved per Section 3.1.5; I/O queues deleted; transient state reset.
